Job description

Position: Sales Manager

Experience: 4-7 Years

Eligibility & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline. B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Life Sciences/Biology will be preferred. MBA will be an added advantage.
  • Sales experience in the healthcare, medical diagnostics, pharmaceutical, or genetic testing industry.
  • Knowledge of genetics and molecular diagnostics will be an added advantage

Location: Pan India (Mumbai/ Pune/Nagpur/ Bangalore/ Kolkata/ Gurgaon)

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue targets.
  • Establish partnerships with doctors, clinics, and hospitals and other healthcare professionals to promote genetic testing services.
  • Promote the company's diagnostic services through regular field visits and product presentations.
  • Identify and generate new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market research.
  • Conduct promotional and branding activities within the assigned territory.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and market developments
  • Prepare and submit regular sales reports and business updates.

Skills Required:

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently as well as in a team.
  • Target-oriented with strong business development capabilities.

Preferred Candidate Profile:

  • Willing to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
  • Owns a two-wheeler with a valid driving licence.
  • Stable employment history with consistent performance.
  • Local candidates will be preferred.
